threshold: every Active acceptance has a named approver, named owner, justification, and a future expiry within 12 months of approval
detail: 1 open accepted risk(s); all bounded with named approver + justification + future expiry (<=12mo)

board_tolerance.basis: DORA Art. 5(2) — the management body shall determine the appropriate risk tolerance level of ICT risk; residual risk must remain within it.
board_tolerance.iso_27001_2022: Clause 6.1.2 — risk acceptance criteria are board-approved; each accepted risk has a named risk owner.

residual_risk.statement: As of 2026-06-22, 1 accepted ICT risk(s) remain open, each formally approved, justified, and time-bounded. Residual risk is asserted to remain within the board-approved risk tolerance (DORA Art. 5(2)); this statement is to be signed by the accountable officer at seal time.
